job: Meet the approved R03 visual and performance contract with progressive hero geometry plus one authored alpha-tested mid-field botanical atlas.

inputs.retainedSystem: bounded worker-built near hero grass and deterministic flower clusters
inputs.replacementBoundary: coarse fill, mid and far live triangles only

required: owned reproducible grass-and-flower atlas with checksum and generation source
one alpha-tested instanced atlas draw for mid-field clumps with fixed LOD bounds
worker-built near hero blades and deterministic near/mid flower heads
textured far meadow with no extra far triangle stream
rich static reduced-motion, low-power and WebGL fallback
fixed-camera vegetation and flower evidence at the approved thresholds

rejectionGates: any synchronous whole-field instance generation or texture rasterization enters runtime
more than two botanical draw programs are added
alpha blending or overdraw replaces alpha-tested/cutout rendering
promotion continues after a causal task over 50 ms or frame-budget failure
opening or close vegetation coverage is below 98 percent of the approved baseline
opening or close flower-head visibility is zero
desktop active-frame p95 exceeds 16.7 ms or mobile exceeds 33.3 ms
the proof uses software rendering, generic whole-image edge coverage, or a different camera/quality tier

anchors: atlas source hash and alpha occupancy
causal long tasks and p95 active frames

failedEvidence.decision: Do not ship or weaken the gate. The one bounded R03A repair improved the opening ratio from 0.8178 to 0.8954 but did not meet 0.98. A materially distinct successor or rollback is required.
